mentions.name: Scan17
mentions.description: Scan17 is an automated network port change detection service that works like nmap port scan diffing: when a network port goes from closed to open, it sends an email or webhook alert so teams learn about exposed ports before attackers. It offers a REST API for automated workflows, plans with privately hosted engines, and a wait-list form on the website.
mentions.problem: Outsourced firewall management can carelessly leave network ports open, exposing production databases, and teams need a way to find out before an attacker does.
mentions.audience: Infosec / cyber security professionals; the author is recruiting early product designers / beta testers from that field.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Automated network port change detection. Scan17 provides a solution to the question:

So your CTO decides to outsource firewall management - and the vendor carelessly leaves a network port open, exposing your production database. How does your team find out before an attacker?

Think of it as nmap port scan diff-ing. If a network port goes from closed to open you get an email or webhook alert.
